jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Remote Data Analyst to join our team. The Data Analyst will be responsible for interpreting data, analyzing results, and providing actionable insights to support business decision-making, all in a remote setting.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and organize large datasets from various sources

Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, etc.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams remotely to understand data needs

Present findings and recommendations clearly and effectively through virtual meetings and reports

Identify areas for process improvement and data quality enhancement

Ensure data accuracy and integrity

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field

Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role

Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.)

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration

Knowledge of programming languages like Python or R is a plus

Preferred Skills

Experience with big data tools (Hadoop, Spark)

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)

Understanding of statistical methods and data modeling

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Vanguard is a global leader in investment management and financial services, committed to helping clients achieve their financial goals through innovative products and exceptional service. With a long-standing reputation for integrity, transparency, and client-centricity, Vanguard continuously strives to empower individuals and institutions to make informed investment decisions. The company fosters a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and innovation, ensuring that its team members are equipped to meet the evolving needs of clients in a dynamic financial landscape. Vanguard’s mission is to put clients first and to deliver long-term value through responsible management and cutting-edge solutions.

About The Role

This analyst role at Vanguard offers a unique opportunity to partner closely with business leaders to enhance client retention and service recovery efforts within the Workplace Solutions division. The primary focus is on analyzing client behavior, identifying risk signals, and uncovering drivers of attrition. The successful candidate will be instrumental in translating complex data into actionable insights, enabling the organization to proactively address client concerns and improve overall satisfaction. The role involves building and maintaining reporting assets, contributing to risk models, and supporting data-driven decision-making processes across various service and retention initiatives. The analyst will also play a vital role in monitoring client sentiment, service issues, and prioritizing interventions that positively impact client experience and loyalty.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of five years of relevant experience, with at least three years dedicated to advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, or business intelligence. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field is required, or an equivalent combination of training and experience. Proficiency in SQL is essential for querying, data extraction, and performance optimization. Expertise in Python or R for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics is also required. Additionally, hands-on experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is necessary to create interactive and insightful reports. The candidate should demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex findings effectively to non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Engage with internal partners to understand business strategies, questions, and goals. Bring structure to business requests, translate requirements into analytical project approaches, and lead projects through completion. Delegate tasks and provide tactical and strategic guidance to peers.
Acquire and compile structured and unstructured data, verifying its quality, accuracy, and reasonableness to ensure reliable analysis.
Perform analyses of historical data to identify trends and insights using advanced analytical methods. Validate analytical techniques employed by other team members to maintain consistency and accuracy.
Prepare and deliver visualizations and internal presentations that translate analytic insights into tangible, actionable solutions for business partners to implement effectively.
Develop, own, and manage recurring analytics or reporting processes to ensure continuous and timely delivery of insights.
Mentor, coach, and train junior data analysts, sharing knowledge of best practices, expanding understanding of business contexts, and fostering a collaborative team environment.
Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned, contributing to the overall success of the team and organization.

Benefits

Vanguard offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. The company promotes a flexible working environment, including a hybrid work model that balances remote work with in-person collaboration. Employees have access to continuous learning opportunities, leadership development programs, and a collaborative workplace culture that encourages innovation and teamwork. Vanguard also provides resources for work-life balance, wellness initiatives, and employee assistance programs to support overall health and personal development.

Equal Opportunity

Vanguard is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds strengthen our organization and enable us to better serve our clients. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status. Vanguard values and promotes an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

Why Join Us:

Role Responsibilities

• Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical analysis to support decision-making
• Develop and deploy machine learning models where applicable
• Create dashboards and reports using BI tools to communicate insights effectively
• Write complex SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from multiple sources
• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into analytical solutions
• Monitor data quality and ensure accuracy and consistency across datasets
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related field
• Experience in data analysis, data science, or a similar role
• Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy) or R
• Advanced SQL skills for data querying and transformation
• Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
• Solid understanding of statistics, probability, and data modeling
• Experience working with large datasets and relational databases

Preferred

• Experience with machine learning frameworks (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch)
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Knowledge of ETL processes and data pipeline development
• Experience with big data tools (Spark, Hadoop)
• Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation

jobs.title: Senior Geologist – Major NATM Tunnel Project | New York, USA
jobs.description:
My client is seeking an experienced Senior Geologist
to join a major tunnel infrastructure project in New York
. This is an excellent opportunity to play a leading technical role on a challenging NATM (New Austrian Tunnelling Method)
project, acting as the Designer's Representative
and providing expert guidance throughout the construction phase.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership and coordinate the on-site team, including geologists, tunnel inspectors, and site supervisors.
Oversee the implementation and compliance of excavation and ground support works in accordance with the Required Excavation and Support (RES) specifications.
Ensure all construction activities are executed in line with the approved design, project specifications, and relevant quality and safety standards.
Assess and interpret geological and hydrogeological conditions throughout tunnel excavation.
Prepare and review daily, weekly, monthly, and final project reports.
Work closely with the construction management team, designers, and key project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
Monitor construction progress and provide technical recommendations to optimize excavation methods, sequencing, and overall project performance.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Civil Engineering, Engineering Geology, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 15 years' experience on NATM tunnel construction projects.
Previous experience working on large-scale international tunnelling projects.
Strong understanding of NATM construction methods, excavation techniques, ground support systems, and tunnelling equipment.
Extensive experience assessing geological and hydrogeological conditions in underground construction.
Demonstrated ability to lead and manage multidisciplinary site teams.
A proactive, solutions-focused approach with excellent organizational and communication skills.
Valid authorization to work in the USA
